nodes.norm_label: adr-006: full .claude/ engineering-process scaffolding despite solo scope

nodes.label: ADR-009: On-demand AWS EC2 for dbt build via GitHub Actions
nodes.rationale: 113M+ row int_trips_enriched build exceeds local dev machine's free RAM/disk; a self-terminating on-demand r6i.xlarge EC2 instance launched via workflow_dispatch avoids always-on cost while solving the memory-bound aggregation/join job, using OIDC federation instead of stored AWS keys.

nodes.label: ADR-010: Query-Plan Fine-Tuning Budget Exception
nodes.rationale: SPEC-014's schema-agnostic QueryPlan intermediate representation requires fine-tuning gpt-5.4-nano on OpenAI's API, incurring real cost; gated behind explicit human approval, a base-model baseline (53.8% exact-match NYC, 66.7% synthetic schema), and a capped ~300-example dataset to bound spend while keeping all live-serving paths $0-budget.

nodes.label: Dashboard Widget Fabrication Audit Finding
nodes.rationale: ~28 of ~55 dashboard widgets were found hardcoded despite claiming live provenance, 3 fabricated by multiplying a real prediction by invented constants, 2 citing artifacts that didn't exist; all fixed by wiring real algorithm/platform artifacts.
